body.name: \(J_{b,n}(a)\), \(\underline m^{\mathrm{cert}}_n\), and \(\overline m^{\mathrm{cert}}_n\)
body.construction: For \(b\in\mathscr B_{n,\alpha}\) and \(a\in I\), let \(J_{b,n}(a)\) be the outward-rounded interval evaluation of \(\mu_Q(a)=\sum_{x\in\mathcal X}p_{x,Q}q_{x,Q}(a)/f_{x,Q}(a)\) over all coordinates and certified remainders in \(b\), with the denominator interval intersected with \([\kappa,\infty)\). If \(\mathscr B_{n,\alpha}\neq\varnothing\), set \(\underline m^{\mathrm{cert}}_n(a)=\min_{b\in\mathscr B_{n,\alpha}}\inf J_{b,n}(a)\) and \(\overline m^{\mathrm{cert}}_n(a)=\max_{b\in\mathscr B_{n,\alpha}}\sup J_{b,n}(a)\); otherwise set both evaluations to zero.
